Be the first to line up three of your symbols (X or O) in a line, which can be horizontal, vertical, or diagonal.
In tic tac toe's Pyramid mode, players start on boards at the bottom of a pyramid and advance to higher boards as they win, making the game more challenging and fun.
5x5 tic tac toe expands the classic board to 5x5 cells, where the goal is to line up four symbols in a row. This variation offers a more complex and strategic game.
Tic Tac Toe Ultimate interconnects nine tic tac toe boards, where each move determines the next board to be played, adding a deep strategic layer to the game.
